name: telmoni-observability
description: Records each turn of your Claude Code sessions in Telmoni as a run: the models, their tokens, the tools and the times. Never a prompt, a reply, a thought, a tool's input or output, or a path.

TELMONI_API_KEY.title: Telmoni API key
TELMONI_API_KEY.description: A project API key holding the ingest scope (telmoni_…), from your project's API keys page

TELMONI_ENDPOINT.title: Telmoni endpoint
TELMONI_ENDPOINT.description: Where ingest is served: leave it blank for https://api.telmoni.com, or give your own deployment's machine host
